fatal_blockers: The emitted 178-dimensional lattice does not enforce the eight normalization or 21 consistency equations; those conditions are imposed only by the search filter. Therefore the enumeration excludes legitimate lattice points and cannot establish CVP soundness for the emitted basis and target.

The supplied nine-clause four-variable edge-cover instance gives an exact mod-2 bypass. Its falsification graph has odd connected components, so no clause subset has odd incidence at every assignment; equivalently, an odd set of assignment-incidence vectors XORs to zero, placing the illegal target parity in the honest-difference span.

Binary repetition cannot repair that zero syndrome, and the code s -> (s,s) has constant minimum distance 2 rather than dimension-dependent amplification. Thus the proposed causal mechanism already fails on a finite general-formula instance.

The reported audit distance is not computed against the single emitted target for seven of eight reference assignments. Replacing the fixed-target residual S(h_a+d)-h_0 by d changes the quantity being measured, so the claimed minimum tested distance does not certify the manifest.

The relation family remains exponential, and neither a polynomial-time formula-local generator nor a composition proof for overlapping clause cores is supplied. The three-variable all-clause core does not confront the freed-marginal overlap obstruction.

All positive evidence is bounded to deviations of squared norm at most 12 and cannot imply an asymptotic gap or hardness theorem. SNF invariants alone would also be insufficient to prove equality of two embedded relation lattices without canonical HNF or mutual-containment certificates.
